title: keel frozen intent
description:
The frontmatter of .keel/proposals/

-/intent.md (L5), written by the product seat; the goals are in proposal.yaml. The frozen block lies between the markers in x-keel-frozen-markers and holds the level-2 sections in x-keel-sections, in order; $defs/frozenBlock is what the deterministic parser produces. The contract approval binds the contract_hash ($defs/contractHash); any byte change invalidates it, and acceptance changes only through an amendment and a new contract approval.
$comment: x-keel-sections and x-keel-frozen-markers are annotation keywords registered by scripts/validate.mjs, which checks mapped Markdown examples against them.

frozenBlock.description: The frozen block as the parser reads it, in its approvable state.

signal.description: From the line 'Signal: <text>' in Outcome and signal.

decision_boundaries.description: From the '### May decide' and '### Must ask' lists.

open_questions.description: Must be empty at contract approval: the section reads 'None.'.

failure_model.description: Required content on the system track; 'Not required on this track.' otherwise.

acceptanceCriterion.description: One row of the Acceptance table, whose columns are ACC | Statement | Covers | Evidence; Covers holds R or R#S ids separated by commas.

evidence_mode.description: unobservable needs a Board override with a reason and an expiry before land.

scope.description: Scope, from the backticked globs listed under '### Allowed' and '### Protected'.

contractHash.description: contract_hash = sha256(normalized frozen block + spec.delta blob + arch.delta blob on the system track + rev_hash of every covered requirement). It is frozen at contract approval and never recomputed after archive.
